limitations: One user-selected source. Main seed 1701 and one shorter Q4 replication at seed 1702; no generalization across songs.
Onset candidates have half/double-time aliases. SheetSage2 is a second model estimate, not ground truth.
Melody metric permits octave equivalence but no fitted clock or transposition; not a listening verdict.
Guide priming is continuation conditioning and output includes real forced guide tokens. Metrics exclude them.
Only the input guides in counterfactual speed controls are stretched. Generated continuations are never stretched.
Source and style are acoustically similar; preservation under unrelated target styles remains untested.
Original long-prompt hidden-activation failures and strict decoder waveform failures remain open.
